item.title: Latest Order Of Entry For $5m TAB Golden Slipper
item.description: The Order Of Entry for the 2026 $5 million Group 1-TAB Golden Slipper (1200m) run at Rosehill Gardens on Saturday, 21st March 2026. Golden Slipper Order Of Entry (as at 2nd March 2026).

item.title: Ceolwulf - Out Of Autumn Carnival
item.description: Trainer Mr J. Pride has advised Racing NSW Stewards that following CEOLWULF’s run in the Verry Elleegant Stakes at Royal Randwick on Saturday 28 February 2026, a decision has been made to spell the gelding. All wagering operators are requested to remove CEOLWULF from all betting markets for the Sydney Autumn Racing Carnival.

item.title: Bathurst Races Today - Postponed
item.description: Following an inspection of the track between the 1000m and 900m with a delegation of senior riders and following consultation with those senior riders, the Bathurst meeting has been postponed due to safety concerns with that section.

item.title: Licensed Stablehand Tony Zorzanello Suspended For Six Months
item.description: In December 2025, Racing NSW Officials attended the premises of licensed stablehand Mr Tony Zorzanello at Dalton Park Racecourse, Griffith.
